tutorial.title: Getting the most out of your pro space
tutorial.intro: The complete guide: how the space is organised and how to work with your clients.
tutorial.level1: One space per client. Click a wedding to open its tools: wedding-day schedule, planning & tasks, budget, guests, seating plan, vendors, ceremony…
tutorial.level2: Your own tools, reused in every wedding: address book, templates & catalogues (usual tasks, price list) and client forms.
tutorial.modesTitle: Two ways to work with your clients
tutorial.share: You stay in control. You send a web link (no account needed) or a PDF. Your clients can view but cannot change anything. Ideal if you run all the logistics.
tutorial.collab: You invite the couple: they create a Mariable account and edit the budget, guests, seating plan, drinks and accommodation themselves. Their changes show up on your side in real time, and vice versa.
tutorial.warning: As soon as a couple is invited, their changes apply to your file. Choose between sharing and collaboration when you start the wedding, depending on how you work.
tutorial.routine1: Send the “Discovery & quote” form and download the PDF summary to prepare your proposal.
tutorial.routine2: Create the wedding, then load the standard template and your usual tasks in Planning & tasks.
tutorial.routine3: Import your price list into the Budget.
tutorial.routine4: Send the “Wedding-day brief” form to confirm timings, then build the wedding-day schedule.
tutorial.routine5: Share documents read-only or invite the couple, according to your initial choice.
tutorial.reopen: Reopen this guide anytime with the "Tutorial" button.
